title: bot
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, ownerid, owningbusinessunit, owningteam, owninguser, ProviderConnectionReferenceId, publishedby.

accesscontrolpolicy.description: Defines which users may interact with the agent.

applicationmanifestinformation.description: Stores information with application manifest data such as Teams application information.

authenticationconfiguration.description: Stores information for the authentication configuration.

authenticationmode.description: Defines how the agent should be authenticated to the user.

authenticationtrigger.description: Defines at which point authentication for the agent should be triggered.

authorizedsecuritygroupids.description: Contains a comma-delimited list of up to 20 Entra ID Group IDs that are allowed to interact with the agent.

configuration.description: Used to store content of bot configuration data.

createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

iconbase64.description: Used to visually identify your bot in channels and services.

importsequencenumber.description: Sequence number of the import that created this record.

ismanaged.description: Indicates whether the solution component is part of a managed solution.

language.description: The language identifier (LCID) of this Agent.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the record was modified.

name.description: The display name of the agent.

origin.description: Used to identify the origin used to create the bot.

overriddencreatedon.description: Date and time that the record was migrated.

publishedon.description: Date and time when the agent was last published

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the agent

supportedlanguages.description: The list of supported languages by this bot

synchronizationstatus.description: Used to store information about the synchronization operations of the bot

template.description: Used to identify the template and version used for the bot default content

utcconversiontimezonecode.description: Time zone code that was in use when the record was created.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the record.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the record.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who modified the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who modified the record.

_owningbusinessunit_value.description: Unique identifier for the business unit that owns the record

_owningteam_value.description: Unique identifier for the team that owns the record.

_owninguser_value.description: Unique identifier for the user that owns the record.

_providerconnectionreferenceid_value.description: Unique identifier for Connection Reference associated with Agent.

_publishedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last published the bot.
